title: Nourishing Bouncy Japanese Eggs Takoyaki
description: A traditional Japanese street food featuring bouncy eggs and a delicate floral flavor, often served as a hangover cure in the Chugoku region. This recipe is FODMAP-friendly and features a unique egg wash and cure.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the takoyaki flour and dashi broth until smooth.
Add the eggs to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Stir in the diced octopus, chopped green onion, sesame oil, salt, and bonito flakes.
Heat a takoyaki pan over medium heat and brush with a small amount of sesame oil.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the egg mixture into the pan and cook until the bottoms are lightly browned.
Use a skewer to shape the eggs into balls and continue cooking until all sides are lightly browned.
Serve the takoyaki hot with additional bonito flakes and green onion if desired.
Repeat the cooking process until all of the egg mixture is used, adjusting the heat as needed to prevent burning.
Let the takoyaki cool for a few minutes before serving.
